$comment: Delegation model registry. Owner rule: free Console models ONLY. 'rank' lists are tried in order (fallback on hang/failure). Update rankings from measured results (docs/ops/DELEGATION.md section 6), never from guesses. Ranks from the 2026-10-16 bake-off, re-run for beam-free on 2026-10-19 (DELEGATION.md section 6); docs/content ranks are provisional (bake-off measured coding only).

code.criteria: Write or change source code: unit tests, small features, refactors, bug fixes, type or lint cleanups.

docs.criteria: Write or edit prose documentation: changelog, README, handoff notes, release notes, comments.

content.criteria: Exercise or program content for the knowledge base: instructions, cues, safety notes, descriptions.

analysis.criteria: Read and answer without editing: parse logs, write a regex, search the codebase, summarize files, explain code.

vision.criteria: Look at screenshots or images and describe or compare them.

jev.note: Router asks Jev to classify the task into a category; falls back to keyword rules when Jev is unavailable (it was 'Endpoint is unavailable' on 2026-10-16).
